title: Mind Matters Workshop Preparation
content: Agenda for the upcoming 'Mind Matters' workshop: 1. Introduction to mental health awareness. 2. Coping strategies for anxiety - breathing exercises, mindfulness, and grounding techniques. 3. Importance of community support in mental health. 4. Interactive session with Q&A. 5. Conclusion and feedback collection. Note: Ensure all patient-sensitive information is kept confidential and only general advice is shared.

title: Therapy Session Notes: Emily
content: Date: 02/15/2022. Patient expressed ongoing struggles with severe anxiety and past trauma. Discussed coping mechanisms and planned to introduce more during our 'Mind Matters' workshop. Patient confidentiality is crucial; these notes are not to be shared outside of individual care context.
